MeshOptimiser

Fast.

Fewer triangles, the same shape. It runs in your browser.

Free.

MIT licence. No account, no subscription.

Powerful.

A thousand parts and millions of triangles.

I was optimising big CAD models by hand and got tired of it, so I built the tool I wanted, and I kept building, so it now has tons of features. It converts STEP on your computer, finds repeated parts, hidden screws and tiny details for you, and exports one small GLB. Free, open source, nothing uploaded.

The STEP converter is built on OpenCascade and meshes a big assembly on several cores at once. Models are drawn with three.js and simplified with meshoptimizer. The app itself runs in your browser, with nothing to sign in to. It is all local. I made it as user friendly as I could. Started for fun, as a UX exercise, but it is a serious tool.

Why MeshOptimiser

Heavy CAD in. A fast page out.

  • Made for CAD

    STEP comes in with its names, colours and the whole part tree. Nothing is flattened.

  • Finds by shape

    Repeats, hidden screws and tiny parts are found by what they are, not by what the file called them.

  • Nothing is final

    Every step previews first and has an undo, so you can try anything.

  • Stays with you

    It runs on your computer and nothing is uploaded. Free and open source.

Clean-up tools

Advanced STEP clean-up tools, free in your browser.

All features

Try it

Search is how you get around.

The app’s own search. Type a part, a library item, a command or a sum.

    ↑↓ choose↵ runEsc clear12*25.4 · 2 in · a part’s name

    • search everythingParts, library items, commands and settings, all from one box.
    • calculate and convertType a sum or a length. 12*25.4 is 304.8, and 2 in is 50.8 mm.
    • toggle right thereSwitch things on and off in the results, without opening a menu.
    • learn the keysEvery command shows its shortcut, so you pick them up as you search.

    Try it

    The commands come to you.

    The app’s own Quick wand. Point at a slice, click a command. Select a part and the ring changes to fit it.

    • PointA slice lights up. A group fans its commands out.
    • ClickRuns the command. Click a part first to work on it.
    • Hold WThe ring comes to the pointer. Let go on a slice to run it.
    • EscBack to the middle. Runs nothing.

    Latest release

    v0.37.3

    Full changelog

    Save writes over the file, the window’s title follows the scene, MeshOptimiser can be chosen in Explorer’s Open with list, and a long job tells you when it ends. An FBX keeps the names of its materials.

    • NewSave (Ctrl+S) writes over the file without asking; Save scene as is Ctrl+Shift+S. The window’s title is the scene’s name, with a diamond while changes are not saved.
    • NewMeshOptimiser can be chosen in Explorer’s Open with list for the model files it reads (the installer adds it); OBJ, FBX, STL, 3MF, USD and Collada can be handed to the program too.
    • NewSettings › General › Notifications: a notification when a long job ends in the background, and the percent of a running job in the window’s title.
    • FixMaterial names of an FBX (and other files) were lost; they now come in. Objects with objects under them (Cinema 4D) open as groups, and the pivots set in the file are on the parts.
